hypothesis: A compact natural-prevalence event head over the current frozen GRU ensemble's 5 Hz probability trajectory and local tracking context can identify an exact directed H/A turnover interval, allowing a bounded edge-specific H/A Viterbi cost to retain short spells suppressed by uniform cost 3.
falsification: The candidate fails the predeclared clean +.01 spell screen, feed_like -0.01 floor, or any held-out provider clean macro/D-F1 -0.02 guard; report all outcomes without further arms.
prior_distinction: PR #13 directional head targeted dead/live stoppage/restart events and altered only D/live costs; earlier H/A boundary decoder targeted a class-balanced +/-0.16 s neighborhood and used non-calibrated evidence. This head targets exact directed H/A changes between native-eligible adjacent 5 Hz samples, uses natural prevalence and LLR costs, and adapts only H/A edges under the current full-provider-held-out GRU ensemble.

baseline.decoder: Viterbi switch cost 3, native fps scaled by fps/10

question_and_mechanism.mechanism: One L2 logistic edge-event head per held-out provider, fit only on that fold's existing TRAIN matches. Head predicts two oriented edge rows per valid 5 Hz interval. Features combine source/destination H/A/D ensemble probabilities at both endpoints, oriented H/A log-odds/change, and destination-versus-source control/contact impulse, nearest distance, nearby-player support, plus global ball speed/availability.
question_and_mechanism.target: For each valid pair, H->A positive only for an exact H then A target pair; A->H positive only for A then H. Both orientations are present for every eligible pair. No class balancing or event undersampling.
question_and_mechanism.native_eligibility: Training pair requires consecutive 5 Hz indices in the same tracking-derived model_period and every native target in the sampled interval known H/A. D/X-containing intervals are excluded. Unknown X never creates a block reset; time blocks are built from period/timestamps only.
question_and_mechanism.sampling: 5 Hz uniform block-local samples from frozen caches. No forced minimum duration; one-native-frame spells remain representable by the decoder.
question_and_mechanism.training_weighting: Equal provider mass, then equal match mass within provider, then equal edge-row mass within match; natural weighted event prevalence is retained.
question_and_mechanism.training_prediction_provenance: For leave_out_X, the exact same without_X two-seed frozen combined models generate ensemble probabilities on every TRAIN record. These backbone predictions are in-sample for training matches, disclosed; evaluation provider X is excluded from every learned component.
question_and_mechanism.transform: Weighted training-only feature median imputation, weighted mean and standard deviation; no evaluation-derived statistic.

fixed_cost_mapping.q: predicted natural-prevalence probability for one directed edge over the adjacent 0.2 s event window
fixed_cost_mapping.cost: clip(3 - llr, 1.5, 4.5), in supervised.decode 10 Hz log-likelihood units
fixed_cost_mapping.native_time_grid: Hold each sampled 0.2 s interval's two directed costs across native rows (left_sample+1 ... right_sample inclusive); the decoder multiplies by fps/10. At block starts/discontinuities and uncovered rows, cost remains 3.
fixed_cost_mapping.D_live: all H/A<->D transition penalties remain exactly 3*fps/10

question_and_mechanism.emissions: Use archived current equal-probability seed ensemble unchanged; no P(H/A/D) modification or renormalization.
question_and_mechanism.seeds: One deterministic head per held-out provider trained on the actual 50/50 two-seed ensemble trajectory; no separate head-seed fits.

fold.interpretation: Unseen-source transfer on historically evaluated development matches
fold.normalization: Fit on these training records only, separately for every learned component
fold.evidence: Historical development; splitting does not create fresh confirmation

sportec.base_prediction_policy: Apply the exact two frozen without_<heldout provider> combined checkpoints to that fold's TRAIN records, then arithmetic-average their full H/A/D probabilities. Train-record base predictions are in-sample for the backbone; all learned components exclude the held-out evaluation provider.

cohort.historical_exposure: All five evaluation matches are previously exposed development data; Metrica/SkillCorner labels are event-derived silver; feed_like is synthetic.

evaluation.primary: official greedy H/A spell F1, mean IoU 0.3/0.4/0.5/0.6/0.7
evaluation.tie_break: macro F1 on exact spell ties
evaluation.auxiliary: 0.70 spell + 0.30 macro; not a ranking metric
evaluation.aggregation: average feed_like replicates within match; matches within provider; providers equally
diagnostics: both frozen component seeds and actual probability ensemble
evaluation.public_labels: Never read, score, select or tune on organizer public labels; no organizer scoring gate is opened.

budgets.fit_method: CPU L2 logistic only; no GRU refits
